visualCharacteristics.purpose: Multi-step self-assessment questionnaire (rating statements, then contact details) with step tabs and Previous / Next / Finish navigation

contentPattern.structure: One row per step: cell 1 step title (e.g. 'Instructions:', 'Information'); cell 2 intro copy plus a numbered list whose items become rating statements, and/or a link to a .json field sheet (Name, Label, Type, Mandatory, Options, Value) for the contact step; optional cell 3 right-rail image. Optional config rows keyed by the first cell: 'Scale' (comma-separated answer labels, first scores highest; default Strongly agree..Strongly disagree), 'Submit' (link to the endpoint answers are POSTed to as {data}), 'Results' (content shown after Finish, with {score} and {max} placeholders)

usage: The Organizational Health and Wellness Pulse Check questionnaire page (/services/consulting/hr/organizational-health-and-wellness-pulse-check). The catalog captured only the step tabs and the Previous/Next buttons; this one block replaces the whole wizard form.
reuseGuidance: Use for any scored multi-step self-assessment. Single-step lead forms belong in the form block.
